response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component BSK_MyoF_IL8 was analyzed at the endpoint, BSK_MyoF_IL8, in the positive analysis fitting direction relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of binding reporter, gain or loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand protein changes. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the 'cytokine' intended target family, where the subfamily is 'interleukins'.
response.assayComponentDesc: BSK_MyoF_IL8 is an assay component measured in the BSK_MyoF assay. It measures IL-8 antibody related to regulation of gene expression using ELISA technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Interleukin 8 (IL-8/CXCL8) is a chemokine that mediates neutrophil recruitment into acute inflammatory sites. IL-8 is categorized as an inflammation-related activity in the MyoF system modeling pulmonary myofibroblast development.
